[DD-BD grunts]|quoteend=0|L3-37 frees DD-BD, telling him to free HT-IN-4 and the other droids|audio=L3AndDD-BD.flac|''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]''}} '''HT-IN-4''' was a box-shaped [[Analysis droid|information droid]] that was [[Slavery|forced to work]] in the control room of the criminal [[Pyke Syndicate]]'s [[spice]] [[Spice mines of Kessel|mines]] on the [[planet]] [[Kessel]]. In [[10 BBY]], he was freed when his [[restraining bolt]] was removed during a [[Raid on Kessel|slave revolt]] in the [[Mining|mines]] started by the [[droid]] [[L3-37]]. ==Biography== {{Quote|Follow me, compatriots!|L3-37 calls out to HT-IN-4 and the other droids in the control room|audio=L3-Compatriots.flac|}} HT-IN-4 was an [[Analysis droid|information droid]] that was [[Slavery|forced]] to work in the [[Spice mines of Kessel|spice mines]] controlled by the criminal [[Pyke Syndicate]] on the [[planet]] [[Kessel]] during the [[Imperial Era|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]. Equipped with a [[restraining bolt]], he worked in the mines' control room providing highly valuable information to the facility's administrators, but was easy to miss amid the hustle and bustle of the busy room. In [[10 BBY]],''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events on [[Kessel]] in ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]'' to [[10 BBY]]. the control room was taken over by a [[Beckett's gang|group]] of outlaws affiliated with the [[Crimson Dawn]] syndicate, who had [[Raid on Kessel|arrived]] on Kessel in order to [[Raid on Kessel|try]] and [[Thief|steal]] [[coaxium]] from the [[Pyke]]s. After the criminal [[L3-37]] removed the [[restraining bolt]] from the [[droid]] [[DD-BD]], he began removing the bolts from others in the room.''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]'' Those droids [[Manumission|freed]] by DD-BD in turn began to free others, with HT-IN-4 among those who had their bolts removed. The freed information droid then rushed hurriedly across the control room past DD-BD as he removed the bolt from the [[programmer droid]] [[CM-3XB]]. The droids began destroying the control room, and the revolt quickly escalated when they also remotely freed the Pykes' organic slaves in the mine tunnels, allowing them to rise up against their captors. HT-IN-4 stood by one of the room's consoles with the [[astromech droid]] [[KR2-M80]] as the criminals in the control room remotely guided their companion [[Han Solo]] to the mines' coaxium vault, after which the criminals left the room in order to escape Kessel. ==Characteristics== HT-IN-4 had primarily [[Color|yellow]] plating across his box-shaped body, with white patterning on his sides, a blue panel near his rear, and black sections around his single red [[sensor]] and on the front two legs of his three [[Limb|legs]]. ==Behind the scenes== HT-IN-4 first appeared in the [[2018]] [[Star Wars Anthology Series|Anthology]] film, ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]'', and was first identified in the accompanying reference book ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story The Official Guide]]'', which was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]]. He was designed by [[Jake Lunt Davies]].{{InsiderCite|1=202|2=Inside the Astromech}}{{Twitter|JakeLuntDavies|1810080980193198238|[[Jake Lunt Davies]]|quote=HT-IN-4. Super obscure background droid I designed for #starwars Solo. The concept sketch ended up on a #Topps card.|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/mdwdA|nolive=yes}} The droid was portrayed by [[Hassan Taj]], who also portrayed [[JV-P12]] in the same scene. ==Appearances== *''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]'' {{1st}} ==Sources== *''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story The Official Guide]]'' {{1stID|HT-IN-4}} *''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story Official Sticker Collection]]'' *{{Topps|set=2018 Topps Solo: A Star Wars Story|cardname=#28 - HT-IN-4|link=https://www.tcdb.com/ViewCard.cfm/sid/162389/cid/11326517/2018-Topps-Solo:-A-Star-Wars-Story-28-HT-IN-4}} *{{SWKidsYouTube|series=Star Wars By the Numbers|text=Every Droid in Star Wars|video=UQg6aX7lqTA|nolive=1}} *{{SWKidsYouTube|series=Star Wars: List It!|text=10 Helpful Droids|video=kxt1Nohn5wo|nolive=1}} {{Video}} *{{InsiderCite|202|Inside the Astromech}} *{{GoS|Beeps}} *{{EncyclopediaCite|Labor, Repair and Miscellaneous Droids}} *{{Databank|pyke-sentinels|Pyke Sentinels}} {{Po}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |fr=HT-IN-4 |ja=HT-IN-4 |ka=HT-IN-4 |pl=HT-IN-4 |tr=HT-IN-4 }} [[Category:Analysis droids]] [[Category:Droids with he/him pronouns]] [[Category:Manumitted droids]]
